meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用 Centinela 代理对代码进行深度安全审计，包括 OWASP Top 10 检查、硬编码密钥扫描、依赖漏洞审计等，并生成审计报告。
howto.when: 当你运行 /security-audit 命令时触发，可指定目录。通常在发布前、重大代码变更后或定期安全审查时使用。

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 目录做安全审计。
say.note: Claude 会审计该目录并生成报告。

say.text: 运行安全审计，检查整个项目。
say.note: Claude 会审计 src/ 目录并输出报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the Centinela agent to perform a deep security audit, including OWASP Top 10 checks, hardcoded secrets scanning, dependency vulnerability auditing, and generates a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by running the /security-audit command, optionally with a scope. Typically used before releases, after significant code changes, or for periodic security reviews.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on src/payments/.
say_en.note: Claude audits that directory and generates a report.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the whole project.
say_en.note: Claude audits src/ and outputs a report.
